inputsRead: git diff HEAD for Experience.tsx and Experience.module.css (actual final diff)
summary: The fixer followup resolves the sole outstanding high-severity concern from review.json (C4-SSR-BARS). The unconditional 1600ms fallback and the animationReady/data-animate scaffolding are gone; static default paints scaleX(1); the entry beat is now a genuine one-shot CSS keyframe animation triggered exclusively by data-entered, which itself is set only when the IntersectionObserver actually fires with isIntersecting or with boundingClientRect.bottom < 0. Prefers-reduced-motion continues to disable animation and hold bars at final width. The three other fixes (NESTED-FOCUS, STAGE-STATE, MENU-TARGET) were already approved and are unchanged by this followup.

verificationEvidence: grep of Experience.tsx: no occurrences of 'animationReady', 'data-animate', 'setTimeout', or '1600'.

Experience.tsx useEffect body: constructs IntersectionObserver with threshold 0.35; commit() sets entered and disconnects; commit() only invoked from (a) the IO callback when entries.some(isIntersecting || boundingClientRect.bottom < 0), or (b) the typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined' guard for environments without IO. No eager post-hydration commit path remains.

Experience.module.css:311-317: .trackBar default declares transform: scaleX(1) with no transition — SSR/JS-blocked paint shows full-length bars, matching the JS-blocked assertion in tests/e2e/adversarial-repairs.spec.ts:35-58.

Experience.module.css:319-333: .trackField[data-entered] .trackBar applies `animation: trackBarEnter 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both` with per-row stagger (60ms) driven by keyframes from scaleX(0) to scaleX(1). Because CSS animations run once on class application and `both` retains the final frame, this is a genuine one-shot entry — the bars only collapse-then-draw at the moment data-entered is added, i.e. real viewport arrival, and remain at scaleX(1) thereafter with no re-trigger on subsequent scrolls.

Experience.module.css:715-722: prefers-reduced-motion selector covers both .trackBar and .trackField[data-entered] .trackBar, zeroing animation, animation-delay, transform, transition, transition-delay, will-change — RM-compliant final width with no motion.
invariantsPreserved: Per-row 60ms stagger preserved (now via animation-delay instead of transition-delay).
One-shot semantic preserved and strengthened: observer.disconnect() on commit prevents re-fire; keyframe with `both` prevents re-animation on class re-evaluation.
Absent-IO environments still commit to final visible state.
prefers-reduced-motion correctly extended to the new animation selector.
